root_cause: The legacy 'Vraag het je portaal' function used a fixed Anthropic provider despite newly saved customer AI model preferences. To prevent unnoticed data transfer, it was blocked for selected models; there was no authorized tenant-provider path for grounded portal QA.
prevention_rule: When the tenant selected a model, the portal-question handler now exclusively invokes the same server-owned, signed tenant inference gateway used by the model smoke test, passing only authenticated server-projection context bounded to 9000 chars. A mismatch, unprovisioned provider, unavailable consent, invalid region, or unresolved supplier status fails closed, with no legacy fallback. The browser cannot pass its own context or provider to the gateway.

outcome.implementation: Tenant selected provider QA route and server-context trust boundary
